message.reasoning: We need to fill fuel tank. The tank capacity is 50 gallons. We have 10 liters. Need to convert to gallons? But we can just fill to full. The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to decide how much to add. If we want to fill to full, we need to know current fuel level in gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert 10 liters to gallons: 1 liter ~ 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters ~ 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So we need to add 47.35828 gallons. But maybe we can just fill to full by adding 50 gallons? That would exceed capacity. The function likely will handle it. But better to add 47.36 gallons. Let's round to 47.36. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.
